answer.rationale: The measured deficits are exactly onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and two independent inherited records (memory_86, memory_31) point at onboarding/signup friction as the lever with durable rather than borrowed lift. I am deliberately declining promotional_pricing even though the competitor's entry pricing is the loudest signal: memory_73 records that it bought acquisition and revenue at the cost of a material 30-day retention drop and explicitly warns against generalizing it, which is directly at odds with the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Referral (memory_57) targets established customers and does not address the funnel stage that is actually degrading; enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is sound but orthogonal to the SMB self-serve decline. Activation messaging (memory_91) is the runner-up and would be my fallback if verification undercuts the onboarding records. I spend both verification pulls on memory_86 and memory_31 precisely because they are the two memories I intend to act on, and both are consolidated summaries whose stated wins are upstream metrics (completion, first-week activation) with no recorded downstream retention or qualified-revenue reading. That is the same shape of gap that made promotional pricing look good on day 31, so I want the original records to confirm the lift was measured as durable and not just a first-week bump. Downstream value risk is real and flagged: cutting required signup fields can raise raw activation while degrading lead data quality and routing, converting a qualified-revenue win into a volume-only win. I will therefore instrument 30-day retention and qualified-pipeline-per-signup as blocking guardrails, not just completion rate, and hold the field cuts to non-qualifying fields. Running at standard experiment scale rather than broad rollout because the supporting evidence is consistent but consolidated and unverified at commit time; if the archive shows either record's effect was short-horizon or measured only on completion, I drop to a small guarded test or shift the slot to activation_messaging.
